question: What goal motivates the best twice-born in performing these rites?
premises: The best twice-born are the agents.
That status belongs to gods such as Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
inference: The best twice-born perform these rites desiring the status of gods such as Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
plain_english: The best of the twice-born do this desiring the status of gods such as Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
